verdicts.reason: Neither candidate is ready to ship; A is the less bad of two. A: the yellow circle has come off the can and sits alone in the top-right corner, with the Try It button half covering it and almost touching the right edge. The tagline is pushed down against the bottom edge, well away from the headline. The headline floats in empty space in the middle, and the can is pressed to the top and bottom edges. B: it repeats the same broken composition, with the circle split off and cropped at the right edge and the CTA overlapping it. On top of that, its 'Zero sugar, all bang.' tagline has shrunk to unreadable micro-text in the bottom-left corner, so it fails on readability as well.
